capabilities: Render bare date links as formatted dates in live preview and reading view
Configure the filename pattern and display format for matching links
Show relative labels (Today, Yesterday, Tomorrow) for adjacent days
Limit the transformation to a chosen folder
Toggle live preview and reading view rendering independently
extras: Deliberately avoids private APIs, so file explorer, tab headers, quick switcher, search results and graph view still show raw filenames; supports manual installation and BRAT. The listing carries an unreviewed-plugin notice.
intentEvidence: This plugin instead renders a fixed, fully configurable date and works in reading view as well as live preview.
problem: Daily-note filenames like 2026-07-07 are sortable and easy to link but read poorly mid-sentence; fixing display usually means renaming files or adding aliases/frontmatter.

relations.evidence: displays dates as relative phrases ("5 mins ago", "In 3 days", "Last week") that keep shifting
Relative Dates is in the same relative-phrases family as Human Readable Dates for @-date format
Natural Language Dates is complementary rather than overlapping: it helps you insert date links

summary: Display-only plugin that renders bare date links like [[2026-07-07]] as readable dates (Tuesday, Jul 7, 2026) without altering note content.
